g.text: I3: every required check passed on the head commit
Read the login of the Reviewer App
and the last cumin/status/ready of the issue
Count the round from the reviews on GitHub
Write the head commit and a zero count
of second requests to the state file
(round 1: review only the diff from it)
The Reviewer approved an earlier commit?
blocked: hand back to the Owner at once (row I10).
Abnormal end: retry once in a new session,
then hand back to the Owner (row I3).
The way out of cumin/status/reviewing: every poll, and the end of a Reviewer run
A Reviewer runs for the issue?
Read the issue again, with the facts:
who added the label and when, the question comments,
the last cumin/status/ready, the state file
Do nothing; tell the Owner once
The label is of cumin-core or of an Owner?
Decide with the pure function ReviewEnd
A question comment after the label?
I10: change the label to cumin/status/awaiting-decision
(the old review still counts as a round)
a required check does not pass
Hand back to the Owner (row I6)
I5: change the label to cumin/status/implementing
Ask the Implementer to fix the comments
(its own session, the branch of the pull request)
A decision request of the Reviewer
I8: change the label to cumin/status/awaiting-decision
Hand back to the Owner (row I8)
I8: ask the Reviewer to explain the cause
Count the request in the state file
(after a run: the short text in its session,
at a poll: the whole review request)
Hand back to the Owner (row I5)
